correctness.rationale: The entire double is explicitly obtained from the suspended tetrahedron partitions, with no missing edges: there are \(m+2n\) vertices and \(4m\) edges. The opposition graph identity yields each component and its exact integral circle rank. The connected dual graph propagates a three-entry component-label multiset across all faces, proving the 1/2/3 trichotomy and 0/1/3 exact-transversal law; proper three-colorability follows in both directions. The sphere-only even-degree equivalence follows from simply connected dual 2-cell transport. The checker reconstructs the double independently and passes seven named examples plus 96 edge flips, but infinite correctness rests on the proof.

value.rationale: This determines complete integral homotopy of the doubles for every connected closed triangulated surface after suspension, not merely a single finite example. The opposition-graph component criterion gives the sharp global possibilities 1,2,3 and exact individual free-group ranks, all realizable already by triangulated spheres. It establishes an exact-triangle-transversal 0/1/3 structural law and an Euler-characteristic formula that applies to non-spherical surfaces. The statement distinguishes different triangulations of the same topological sphere and supports studying doubles beyond general connectivity bounds.
